name: Sixty Minutes to Kickoff
why_it_works: Fans want access to the moment before the moment. A countdown structure creates built-in suspense, every beat is closer to the start, and the pre-game ritual details make the audience feel like insiders.

hook.pattern: Put a countdown on screen and start inside the locker room or green room.
examples: What the hour before {{event}} actually looks like.
Phones off in 60. Here's everything before that.

variables.name: event
variables.description: What they are counting down to

variables.name: ritual
variables.example: taping ankles in the same order every game

variables.name: playlist_vibe
variables.description: Mood of the warm-up music (no real songs)

variables.name: last_words
variables.example: Play for the person next to you

variables.name: offer
variables.example: grab tickets for Saturday's home game

visual.prompt: Empty locker room or green room for {{team_name}}, gear laid out on benches, fluorescent light, quiet before the storm, vertical 9:16
Close-up of hands {{ritual}}, focused, shallow depth of field, cool locker room light, vertical 9:16
Athlete or performer seated, eyes closed, big headphones on, back to a wall of lockers, moody side light, vertical 9:16
Tight huddle of {{team_name}} members seen from the center looking up, arms locked, low angle, tunnel light behind, vertical 9:16
Silhouette of the group walking down a dark tunnel toward bright stadium or stage light, vertical 9:16

craft.notes: Each beat opens with a bigger-to-smaller timer so tension builds on its own. Cut faster as the clock drops. End on the walk toward the light and stop before the event itself so fans have to show up to see it.

do_not: Use a real copyrighted song as the warm-up track
Show playbooks, injuries or anything a coach has not cleared
